reason: The plugin is primarily an orchestration utility for DeepSeek Harness subagents: it adds a sidebar web UI to set model and reasoning settings, supports global and per-session scope, and applies these settings dynamically to subagent/workflow operations; this is evidenced by the README feature and usage sections plus the package’s DSH web client/plugin configuration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中提供子代理模型配置入口，可按会话或全局设置供应商、模型和推理强度，以控制子代理使用的模型策略。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Subagent Models configuration panel in the DeepSeek Harness web UI so users can set provider, model, and reasoning effort for subagents globally or per session.

capabilities: Configures provider/model/reasoning settings for subagent execution.
Supports global defaults and per-session overrides for subagent behavior.
Applies updated settings at runtime without requiring a web restart.
Stores configuration data locally in a structured JSON file.

reasons.code: User-facing plugin description and usage flow define the main capability: configuring subagent model/provider/reasoning mode per session or globally via the GUI.
README states settings include global vs session scopes (default/inherit/custom) and are applied to new subagent/workflow requests immediately after save.
README documents configuration persistence at ~/.dsh/storages/subagent_model.json with default and sessions sections.
Package metadata declares DSH web plugin bundle/client wiring, indicating runtime integration with the web interface and subagent-capable context.
